untrusted_input.description: pointer or array containing untrusted encoded input

length_accumulator.description: variable accumulating a decoded length from untrusted input

place_value_multiplier.description: base multiplier used when accumulating a length

output_offset.description: current write offset into the output buffer

output_capacity.description: maximum size of the output buffer

buffer_writer.description: function that writes to a buffer using a size argument

fixed_width_signed_arithmetic_type.description: fixed-width signed integer type that can overflow

widened_safe_type_in_fix.description: widened integer type that avoids overflow in this context
